caption: The drawing consists of a large, ornate circular motif in the center, bordered with multiple rings of small colored shapes—primarily alternating red, orange, yellow, and green—forming a floral and geometric pattern. Inside the circle, there is German text written in black ink across a beige background. Attached to the lower part of the circle is a yellow, heart-shaped area with additional writing. Flanking the circle on either side are large, stylized floral arrangements with symmetrical, curled leaves and buds, primarily colored in yellow, orange, green, and red. At the top left and right, two winged human figures are positioned horizontally and face inward toward the circle; they have pinkish faces, black hair, and brightly colored garments featuring red, yellow, and green stripes. Both appear to be flying or floating, with arms extended toward the center. Above the circle, centered, is a small roundel containing a yellow bird perched on a branch, surrounded by orange and yellow flowers. The upper corners and edges of the drawing also feature clusters of flowers in yellow, orange, and red. The overall composition is highly symmetrical and filled with floral and decorative elements using a limited palette of earthy reds, oranges, yellows, greens, and brownish grays, with all figures and shapes outlined in a thin, dark ink.
title: Baptismal Certificate
